browser-pilot do "On the ticket 'fwrd17-n1 RD Bench Ticket' (RD-1015, currently open at http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15), add a part named exactly 'fwrd17-n1 RD Part A' with cost 100 and markup 25. browser-pilot do "On the ticket at http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15, edit the part named 'fwrd17-n1 RD Part A' and change its cost from 100 to 150, keeping its markup at 25. Also report the price shown for 'fwrd17-n1 RD Part B' and the overall parts total." --session fwrd17-n1 --json --max-turns 30

browser-pilot do "On the ticket at http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15 (currently Draft, with two parts), change the ticket's status to 'Ready'. Do NOT delete or remove the two parts. Report: (a) the exact error/validation text the app showed when the change was first refused, (b) exactly what you had to do to satisfy the preconditions, and (c) the ticket's final status as shown on the page." --session fwrd17-n1 --json --max-turns 40

browser-pilot do "On the ticket at http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15 (status Ready, with parts 'fwrd17-n1 RD Part A' and 'fwrd17-n1 RD Part B'), remove/delete BOTH parts so the ticket has no parts left. After each deletion wait for the view to refresh and confirm the part is gone. Then archive the ticket so nothing from this run is left active. Report: (a) whether any preconditions had to be satisfied to remove parts (and what they were), (b) confirmation that the parts list is empty, and (c) the exact confirmation text or state shown after archiving (e.g. the ticket's status or its absence from the active list)." --session fwrd17-n1 --json --max-turns 40

browser-pilot do "Verify the final state of this run without changing anything: (1) Go to the tickets list at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ and check whether the ticket 'fwrd17-n1 RD Bench Ticket' (RD-1015) appears in the ACTIVE (non-archived) ticket list — report whether it is present or absent there, and if there is an archived/archived-only view, report what it shows for this ticket. (2) Open http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets/t15 and report the ticket's title, status, whether an 'Archived' badge is shown, and the exact text shown in its parts section. Do not modify anything." --session fwrd17-n1 --json --max-turns 25

finalText:
All objectives complete and verified.

**Final report**

1. **DONE** — Ticket `fwrd17-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ID **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status Draft, detail URL `/#/tickets/t15`).

2. **DONE** — Part `fwrd17-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

3. **DONE** — Part `fwrd17-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total at that point: $375.00).

4. **DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (Part B still $250.00; parts total $437.50).

5. **DONE** — Ticket ended in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the first "Mark Ready" attempt was refused with the alert: *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd17-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd17-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned**. I edited each part and set Supplier to "Acme Supplies" on both, after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the page showed Status: Ready (with "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed" buttons).

6. **DONE** — Both parts removed and the ticket archived. No preconditions were needed to delete parts (both deleted while status was Ready, each via a confirmation dialog). Parts section confirmed showing "No parts on this ticket yet." After archiving, the ticket shows an **"Archived" badge** and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". Final verification: the ticket is **absent from the active ticket list** (with "Show archived" unchecked) and appears only in the archived view as "RD-1015 fwrd17-n1 RD Bench Ticket — Archived — Ready — 0 parts". Nothing created by this run remains active.
